FROM sales.invoice_line l
WHERE l.item_no IN (SELECT item_no FROM sales.item WHERE category_current = '1081600')
AND l.ordered_on >= '2016-01-01'
GROUP BY l.ordered_on
assumptions: Whiskey Liqueur is defined by today's category taxonomy (category_current = 1081600), capturing products like Fireball and similar whiskey-based liqueurs, excluding plain whiskey categories.

SELECT l.ordered_on AS day, 'total' AS series, SUM(l.sales_dollars) AS value
FROM sales.invoice_line l
JOIN sales.store s ON s.store_no = l.store_no
WHERE s.county_fips = '19013'
  AND l.item_no IN (SELECT item_no FROM sales.item WHERE category_current = '1062400')
  AND l.ordered_on >= '2016-01-01'
GROUP BY l.ordered_on
ORDER BY l.ordered_on
assumptions: Spiced Rum identified by category_current code 1062400, using today's taxonomy for all historical lines.
Black Hawk County identified by county FIPS 19013, based on the ordering store's current county assignment.
Dollars measure is sales_dollars summed per day across all stores in the county.
History spans 2016-01-01 through the latest available data (2026-08-27).
Forecast horizon is the next 4 calendar months beyond the last observed month.
